entry: internal runScheduledRefreshCheck; no HTTP route or cron installed
authority: private NOLOGIN coordinator function; owner-only disabled generation configuration; generation is NOT HTTP authentication
deduplication: one committed complete queue check per database arrival minute; database clock after locks; same-minute duplicate does not advance sequence, queue revision or heartbeat
late_delivery: a delayed duplicate in a later minute is indistinguishable from a new wakeup; native queue coalescing and existing fenced admission still apply; not exactly-once cron delivery
transaction: refresh_control then refresh_queue_control then refresh_tick_control; native bounded inventory, queue state, heartbeat and receipt commit atomically; no HTTP under lock
failure: inventory error, overflow or unknown commit response cannot authorize dispatch or local success; no retry or fallback
missed_tick: next distinct minute reconciles current native authority and existing pending needs once; no per-missed-minute loop and no disconnected-period backfill
receipt: single current generation/monotonic sequence/database timestamp/queue revision; no event history growth; duplicate and future clock cannot manufacture a healthy check
work: only an explicit trusted planner/verifier/bounded reader may call existing dispatchRefreshPreflight once; same store cannot be overridden; absent plan leaves queue checked and work_policy_required
claim_safety: existing source/entitlement/fence/queue-revision/quota gates remain; generation is checked at queue receipt, not a global freeze across subsequent HTTP work
handoff: awaiting_dataset is not refresh success; claim retained, queue need not cleared, no checkpoint or writer
remaining: authenticated native cron route and explicit generation activation
